ambient: The vault begins the courteous business of closing.
Something waves. It has a great many things to wave with.
The pattern thins, and behind it there's wallpaper.
description: The pattern has begun to fold itself down into a shape you could leave through. This is being done for you, and well, and with a certain formality. There's a great deal of goodwill here and none of it'll come back with you.
name: The Way Back

looks: A shape resolving into something a person could go through.
Folded properly, with corners. Somebody does this for a living.
On the other side of it's a room, and a body, and an evening.
objects.name: the fold

looks: Enormous, and directed at you, and not remotely personal.
They're pleased you came. They see a lot of people.
It won't survive the trip back and everybody knows that.
objects.name: the goodwill

weather: A cool draught comes through the fold, and it smells like the room you left.
